title: 11 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Psoriasis
intro: Herbal essential oils for Psoriasis are a natural and holistic approach to treating the symptoms of this chronic skin condition. These essential oils are highly concentrated plant extracts that have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and moisturizing properties, which help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness, itching, and scaling associated with psoriasis. Some examples of herbal essential oils that are beneficial for psoriasis include Tea Tree Oil, which has antimicrobial properties that help to prevent infection and promote wound healing; Lavender Oil, which has a calming effect on the skin and reduces inflammation; Chamomile Oil, which has anti-inflammatory and soothing properties that help to reduce itching and redness; Geranium Oil, which helps to balance the skin's pH and reduce inflammation; and Frankincense Oil, which has anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that help to promote healing and reduce scarring. By incorporating these herbal essential oils into a treatment plan, individuals with psoriasis may experience improved skin health, reduced symptoms, and a better overall quality of life.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis essential oils have been widely used as a natural remedy to treat psoriasis, a chronic skin condition characterized by inflammation and scaly skin lesions. The anti-inflammatory and soothing properties of aloe vera help to reduce redness, itching, and swelling associated with psoriasis, while also promoting wound healing and skin regeneration. The bioactive constituents of aloe vera, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, exhibit potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities that help to calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and prevent further damage. By using aloe barbadensis essential oils topically, individuals with psoriasis can experience significant relief from symptoms, including reduced inflammation, improved skin texture, and a reduced risk of skin infections.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Tropical medicine & international health : TM & IH", Aloe barbadensis essential oils for psoriasis may be an effective treatment, as a 0.5% Aloe vera extract cream in a hydrophilic cream cured 83.3% (25/30) of patients with slight to moderate chronic plaque-type psoriasis compared to 6.6% (2/30) in the placebo group.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and calm the skin. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, such as triterpenoids and carotenoids, exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities that aid in reducing redness and inflammation associated with psoriasis. The essential oils of Calendula officinalis help to promote wound healing, reduce scaling and thickening of skin, and prevent the formation of keratinocytes, thereby alleviating the symptoms of psoriasis. By incorporating Calendula officinalis essential oils into one's skincare routine, individuals can experience improved skin hydration, reduced inflammation, and enhanced wound healing, ultimately leading to better management of psoriasis symptoms.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the given study, Calendula officinalis essential oils ranked equally with Chelidonium majus L. in terms of dermatologic importance, with a score of 57.78, indicating its potential use for treating psoriasis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, derived from the leaves of the lavender plant, have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to soothe and calm the skin affected by psoriasis. The antiseptic and antimicrobial properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce the severity of psoriasis symptoms by preventing bacterial and fungal infections that can exacerbate the condition. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, including linalool and linalyl acetate, help to reduce inflammation and promote the healing of skin lesions associated with psoriasis. By incorporating Lavandula angustifolia essential oils into a skincare routine, individuals with psoriasis may experience improved symptoms, reduced redness and scaling, and a faster healing process.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, particularly its major components linalool and linalyl acetate, have shown significant anti-psoriatic activity in reducing psoriasis-like skin inflammation by 73.67% in PASI scores and 87% in Th-17 cell-specific cytokines towards normal levels.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica essential oils have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and soothe irritated skin. The herbal preparation's ability to modulate the immune system and inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines also plays a crucial role in alleviating psoriasis symptoms. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins present in Urtica dioica essential oils have been found to possess potent anti-inflammatory and antipruritic properties, making it an effective treatment for psoriasis. The benefits of using Urtica dioica essential oils to treat psoriasis include reduced redness, itching, and scaling of the skin, improved skin elasticity, and enhanced overall skin health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the provided information, Urtica dioica essential oils, which have detergent action and keratolytic effects, may be a safe and promising therapeutic option for treating psoriasis due to its ability to evacuate impurities from the body's excretory system and maintain skin tone consistency.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melaleuca alternifolia essential oils, also known as tea tree oil, have been traditionally used to treat various skin conditions, including psoriasis. The anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties of this herbal preparation help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and itching associated with psoriasis. The bioactive constituents, such as cineole and terpinen-4-ol, possess potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities that help to regulate the immune response and reduce inflammation in the skin. By using Melaleuca alternifolia essential oils topically, individuals with psoriasis may experience relief from symptoms and improved skin health, making it a beneficial natural remedy for managing this chronic condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Adverse drug reactions and toxicological reviews", Melaleuca alternifolia essential oils have activity against inflammatory/immune disorders affecting skin, such as psoriasis.

The bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, in Hypericum perforatum essential oils have been found to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, thereby reducing the severity of psoriasis symptoms. The benefits of using Hypericum perforatum essential oils to treat psoriasis include reduced inflammation, improved skin texture, and enhanced overall well-being.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the information in the study, some plant-derived substances like dithranol and methoxsalen (in combination with UVA) are already accepted as standard treatments in psoriasis, and Hypericum, along with Mahonia and Capsicum (capsaicin), are suggested by present evidence as potential next candidates for psoriasis treatment.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum essential oils, derived from the milk thistle plant, have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including psoriasis. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of this herbal preparation help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation associated with psoriasis. By using Silybum marianum essential oils, individuals with psoriasis can benefit from improved skin hydration, reduced scaly patches, and a decreased risk of infection.

Eucalyptus globulus essential oils have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The terpenes and flavonoids present in this herbal preparation help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, thereby aiding in the treatment of psoriasis. The bioactive constituents such as cineole, limonene, and alpha-pinene in Eucalyptus globulus essential oils have been found to exhibit antiproliferative and immunomodulatory effects, which help to control the growth of abnormal skin cells and alleviate symptoms associated with psoriasis. By using Eucalyptus globulus essential oils topically, individuals can benefit from its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, leading to improved skin health and reduced psoriasis symptoms.

Ginkgo biloba essential oils have been studied for their potential to treat psoriasis, an inflammatory skin condition characterized by red, scaly patches. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of Ginkgo biloba essential oils, particularly its terpene and flavonoid constituents, help to reduce inflammation and promote skin health. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba essential oils, including bilobalide and ginkgolides, have been shown to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory mediators and improve skin barrier function, thereby alleviating psoriasis symptoms. Regular use of Ginkgo biloba essential oils may help to reduce the severity and frequency of psoriasis outbreaks, promoting smoother, healthier-looking skin and improved overall well-being.

preparations.preparation_study: According to available data and the given study, Cymbopogon citratus essential oils are considered as part of the medicinal plants that may be used as a therapeutic adjuvant to improve the quality of life of patients with plaque psoriasis, either alone or in combination with other forms of treatment.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melissa officinalis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipruritic properties, which help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing inflammation and irritation associated with the condition. By reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, Melissa officinalis essential oils can help to improve the appearance and texture of the skin, reducing the visibility of psoriasis lesions and promoting a more even skin tone. Regular use of Melissa officinalis essential oils has been reported to provide relief from psoriasis symptoms, including reduced itching, inflammation, and scaling, as well as improved skin elasticity and hydration.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Melissa officinalis essential oils, specifically the decoction of the plant, shows significant potential in treating psoriasis, primarily by reestablishing skin physiology, decreasing dryness, and enhancing skin barrier function.

Regular use of Zingiber officinale essential oils has been shown to provide relief from psoriasis symptoms, including reduced redness, itching, and scaling, ultimately improving the overall quality of life for individuals affected by this condition.

intro_study: According to "Frontiers in pharmacology", essential oils for psoriasis, specifically a combination of linalool (L) and linalyl acetate (LA) in a 1:1 w/w ratio at 2% concentration, have shown a synergistic effect in ameliorating psoriasis-like skin inflammation and are considered safe for long-term topical use.
